_note: Reviewed skills allowlist. Copy is fixed; the model never writes advice. Each skill has exactly one executor; its type, duration and limits are server-controlled. The model may only supply short display context (e.g. what to focus on). Reviewed against the team's content checklist: no diagnosis names, no treatment or outcome claims, one small action. This is not a clinical review.

skills.title: Prioritize
skills.next_step: Start with the one due soonest. Work only on that for 15 minutes.
steps: Pick the task with the nearest deadline.
Close everything that isn't that task.
Work on only that until the timer ends.

skills.title: Start small
skills.summary: Make starting smaller than the task.
skills.next_step: Open it and do the smallest visible piece for 10 minutes. You can stop when the timer ends.
steps: Open the thing you've been avoiding.
Do the smallest visible piece — a heading, one line, one question.
When the timer ends you may stop. Carrying on is a bonus.

skills.title: Paced breathing
skills.summary: Slow your breathing for one minute.
skills.next_step: Follow the guide: breathe in for 4, out for 6. Six rounds, one minute.
steps: Breathe in through your nose for a count of 4.
Breathe out slowly for a count of 6.
Six rounds. Then notice one thing you can see around you.

skills.title: Reach out to one person
skills.summary: One small message to someone you trust.
skills.next_step: Copy this message and send it to one person you'd be okay hearing from.
steps: Think of one person — a friend, sibling, classmate.
Copy the message below and send it yourself.
You don't have to explain everything. Reaching out is the whole step.

executor.label: message ready to copy
executor.message: Hey — are you free to talk for a bit later today?

skills.title: Wind down
skills.next_step: Follow four short cues, 30 seconds each. Screens down after.
steps: Put your phone face down and dim the lights.
Write down anything still on your mind.
Relax your shoulders and jaw, then rest.

executor.label: 2-minute reset
cues: Put your phone face down and dim the lights.
Write down one thing still on your mind — then leave it there.
Drop your shoulders. Unclench your jaw.
Breathe slowly. When this ends, screens down.

skills.title: Nothing to fix today
skills.summary: Sounds like today is okay. That's a fine check-in.
skills.next_step: No action needed. Still will check in again at your next scheduled time.
